# Emmanuel Chege

> Emmanuel Chege · Hyperrealistic 3D Artist & Motion Designer, based in Nairobi, Kenya. Portfolio of Emmanuel Chege featuring yearly reels, 3D characters, drone show concepts, event visualization, and more.

## Main pages

- [Emmanuel Chege · 3D Artist & Motion Designer in Nairobi, Kenya](https://emmanuelchege.com): Portfolio of Emmanuel Chege featuring yearly reels, 3D characters, drone show concepts, event visualization, and more.
- [3D Characters](https://emmanuelchege.com/characters): In-depth technical breakdowns of my hyperreal, stylized and creature work · sculpt to look-development, with a focus on rendering melanated skin honestly.
- [Drone Show Concepts](https://emmanuelchege.com/drone-shows): Each drone show begins as a narrative written on paper · a story, a script, a sequence of formations designed to tell a message in the night sky.
- [Drawings & Illustrations](https://emmanuelchege.com/drawings-illustrations): Work made on paper and in vector, either side of the 3D. Graphite and charcoal studies from my re-introduction to fine art, and illustration commissioned for print and product.
- [Projection Mapping](https://emmanuelchege.com/projection): Architectural building projections, object mapping and event screen content across Nairobi and beyond.
- [Visualization](https://emmanuelchege.com/visualization): 3D pre-visualization for events and products · event setups previsualized to guide the build and the client, plus product, property and vehicle renders.
- [Hologram](https://emmanuelchege.com/hologram): Raw videos and behind-the-scenes of holograms edited before projection.
- [Event Videos](https://emmanuelchege.com/events): Full event films and launch openers delivered to clients.
- [Social Media Content](https://emmanuelchege.com/social): Branded motion graphics, GIF animations and social-first visual storytelling.
- [About & Contact](https://emmanuelchege.com/contact): Emmanuel Chege · Hyperrealistic 3D Artist & Motion Designer. Available for commissions, collaborations and projects worldwide from Nairobi, Kenya.

## 3D character breakdowns

- [Arya · A Character Texturing Odyssey](https://emmanuelchege.com/characters/arya): A texturing study that became a full pipeline rebuild, ZBrush and ZWrap to Mari, sRGB to ACES, and a search for how melanated skin should truly respond to light.
- [Odungi · The Fairytale](https://emmanuelchege.com/characters/odungi-the-fairytale): A dark African fantasy being, drawn from the mystery, fear and symbolism embedded in traditional African fables.
- [Lolungu · The Turkana](https://emmanuelchege.com/characters/lolungu-the-turkana): A Turkana portrait, weathered skin, beadwork and the optical truth of melanin under hard northern light.
- [Afrezia · The Emerald](https://emmanuelchege.com/characters/afrezia-the-emerald): A cybernetic character built in under two days and nights for the Safaricom Emerald hologram launch, embracing AI-assisted techniques inside a traditional CGI workflow.
- [Omolara · The Omo](https://emmanuelchege.com/characters/omolara-the-omo): An Omo Valley portrait, ceremonial paint, ornament and skin under natural light.
- [Ndirangu · The Farmer](https://emmanuelchege.com/characters/ndirangu-the-farmer): A stylized character study, exaggerated form, hand-crafted appeal, a farmer’s story.
- [Moombi · The Angel](https://emmanuelchege.com/characters/moombi-the-angel): A winged hyperreal figure, feather grooming, luminous skin, a celestial study.
- [Otugi · The Dragon](https://emmanuelchege.com/characters/otugi-the-dragon): A creature build, scale displacement, anatomy and a reptilian shading study.
